_readme: Source of truth for the print shop. Edit here, then run: python3 scripts/build_print_pages.py, then python3 scripts/make_stripe_links.py. Every print is sold in the same standard sizes. 'shape' is the photo's proportions: 3:2 photos print edge to edge, any other shape prints whole on the same paper with a white border, never cropped. 'lede' is the one-line italic under the title and 'story' the paragraph below it; both are optional. 'source_px' is the long edge in pixels of the best file we have for that print (its 'master' path is relative to Dropbox/Career/OxHollow/); a size is only offered if its long side × 150 ppi fits in source_px. 'shopify' (optional) lists Gelato-fulfilled canvas/wood/acrylic variants sold through the Shopify store (shopify_store); each print page shows them as a material picker that links to Shopify checkout.

gelato._readme: Used by scripts/gelato_publish.py. templates: Gelato template IDs per orientation and material (found by name). prices: retail USD per material and size (framed prices from --quote, ~2.5x Gelato cost). frames: frame colours offered on framed print and framed canvas, keyed as the script reads them from Gelato.
